description: Run a controlled browser scenario when passive observation cannot exercise the application. Launch the selected executable or connect to a loopback CDP target, provide a start URL and actions, and select storage or artifacts when needed. Environment, empty storage, a URL-only final capture, and measured event-retention budgets are defaults. capture.network selects request_body, response_body, and header_values independently; capture.limits lets callers raise or lower the event count, retained-allocation estimates, network transaction count, and network content budgets. Selected content is returned inline with transaction and event references, byte digests, and explicit unavailable states. Budget omissions identify affected event kinds and network transactions. Credentials and declared secrets are redacted. Agents can run their own local fixture servers to control application responses. Actions run until completion or cancellation unless timeout_ms is set. Results are returned inline.
